components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #FF8A00; color: #1D1D1D; border: none; border-radius: 12px; padding: 8px 16px; font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; transition: all 300ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #DE6C00; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FF8A00; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-search { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: #FFF2F0; border: 1px solid #FFC9C0; border-radius: 12px; padding: 8px 12px; } .ds-search:focus-within { border-color: #FF8A00; box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgb(255 138 0 / 0.12); } .ds-search kbd { min-width: 20px; height: 20px; border: 1px solid #FFC9C0; border-radius: 6px; background: #FFFFFF; font-size: 12px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }

components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 8px; overflow-x: auto; } .ds-tabs a { position: relative; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 12px; color: #271917; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-tabs a.is-active { color: #FF8A00; } .ds-tabs a.is-active::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 12px; right: 12px; bottom: -6px; height: 2px; background: #FF8A00; }

components.css: .ds-side { width: 18rem; min-width: 16rem; } .ds-side a { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; color: #271917; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; padding: 6px 0; } .ds-side a.is-active { color: #FF8A00; box-shadow: inset 2px 0 0 #FF8A00; }

donts: Don't paint large surfaces in Signal Orange.
Don't stack gradients, glass, glow, or grain; only the header veil and the Ask panel glow.
Don't use pill-shaped buttons or cards.
Don't adopt the earlier reference's light-first cyan system, Montserrat, or blue-grey neutrals; those belong to the Channable direction this system replaced.
Don't swap Manrope for Montserrat or use Manrope as the monospace face.
Don't ship statistics, testimonials, or compliance claims without a real source.
dos: Do use Signal Orange on the primary action, the active tab, and the active sidebar item only.
Do keep neutrals warm: borders #FFC9C0, body #9B5950, headings #271917.
Do set every technical string in IBM Plex Mono.
Do ship the full dark scale beside the light default and verify both.
Do close articles with feedback widget and Last updated, and give code blocks a copy button.
keyCharacteristics: Light-first with a complete dark scale
One orange accent (#FF8A00) on few affordances per screen
Warm red-tinted neutrals, never pure grey
12px radius on every interactive and content container
Manrope for prose, IBM Plex Mono for technical strings
Motion limited to hover lift, state transitions, and panel fade
narrative.overview: A bright reading room where one orange signal does all the wayfinding. Cloned from the live Gravitee documentation through markup, CSS tokens, computed styles, and screenshots. One orange accent does all wayfinding; warm red-tinted neutrals keep long reading calm; Manrope carries the voice and IBM Plex Mono carries every technical string. Light-first with a complete dark scale, 12px radius discipline, and motion reduced to hover lift and panel fades.

rules.body: Signal Orange appears on the primary action, active tab, and active sidebar item, and nothing else on that screen.
rules.name: The One Signal Rule

rules.body: Every neutral is tinted toward red and amber; pure grey is never used for borders, body text, or surfaces.
rules.name: The Warm Neutral Rule

rules.body: Light is the default and the mode this system is specified in; dark is a complete opt-out with its own scale.
rules.name: The Light-First Rule

rules.body: Prose stays in Manrope; anything a user might copy switches to IBM Plex Mono.
rules.name: The Two-Track Type Rule

rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest; shadow and lift appear only in response to state.
rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
